Item Class: Tablet
Rarity: Rare
Void Directive
Abyss Tablet
--------
Item Level: 80
--------
{ Implicit Modifier }
Adds Abysses to a Map
3 uses remaining
--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Breeding" (Tier: 1) }
5(5-7)% increased Pack Size in Map
{ Prefix Modifier "Elevated" (Tier: 1) }
15(12-18)% increased Experience gain in Map
{ Suffix Modifier "of Spirits" (Tier: 1) }
Map has 92(70-100)% increased chance to contain Azmeri Spirits
{ Suffix Modifier "of Dark Power" (Tier: 1) }
27(20-30)% increased chance for Abyssal monsters in Map to have Abyssal Modifiers
--------
Can be used in a personal Map Device to add modifiers to a Map.

Item Class: Tablet
Rarity: Rare
Godless Mandate
Abyss Tablet
--------
Item Level: 81
--------
{ Implicit Modifier }
Adds Abysses to a Map
7 uses remaining
--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Elevated" (Tier: 1) }
14(12-18)% increased Experience gain in Map
{ Prefix Modifier "Challenger's" (Tier: 1) }
Monsters have 10(10-15)% increased Effectiveness
{ Suffix Modifier "of Hollows" (Tier: 1) }
Map contains an additional Abyss
{ Suffix Modifier "of Champions" (Tier: 1) }
2(2-3) additional Rare Monsters are spawned from Abysses in Map
--------
Can be used in a personal Map Device to add modifiers to a Map.
